minutes.headline: Select Board reorganized with a new member and reviewed Monty Tech concept plans for the old primary school site.
minutes.summary: New member Mr. Franco was welcomed and the board reorganized, re-electing the chair and vice chair and naming a clerk. The board reviewed a draft charge for a standing Green Communities committee, due back June 1, and went through Monty Tech student concept drawings for the old primary school site. The town manager reported vacancies, an electricity aggregation rate, a state budget update, a dump-site assessment and COVID updates.

what_happened.line: The Select Board reorganized with a new member seated, re-electing the chair and vice chair on votes where the chair abstained or one member did, and naming a clerk.
The board agreed to use the Monty Tech student concept as a starting point for the old primary school site; the town manager will draft a landscape architect RFP.
A draft charge for a standing Green Communities committee was reviewed, with select board notification added to its resignation provision; it returns June 1 for ratification.
The board ratified the town manager's appointment of a DPW heavy equipment operator unanimously.
The town manager reported a new electricity aggregation contract from November 1, a Senate state budget change, and a dump-site cleanup estimate that would need a town meeting appropriation.

why_it_matters: The old primary school site design money approved at town meeting cannot be spent until July 1, so any landscape architect work on the site follows that date, and a public commenter urged waiting until other building questions are settled.
The electricity supply contract is a fixed rate for 36 months, slightly above the utility's current basic service rate, so it touches household electric bills.
A dump-site cleanup would need a town meeting appropriation, so residents may be asked to vote on it once costs and options are clearer.
watch_next: June 1 Select Board meeting: Green Communities committee charge returns for ratification, and committee assignments were deferred to that date.
Landscape architect RFP for the old primary school site, expected from the town manager by the second or third June meeting.
